arxiv-2108-05878.title: Semiconductor Epitaxy in Superconducting Templates
arxiv-2108-05878.creator: M. F. Ritter, H. Schmid, M. Sousa, P. Staudinger, D. Z. Haxell, M. A. Mueed, B. Madon, A. Pushp, H. Riel, F. Nichele
arxiv-2108-05878.description: Abstract Integration of high quality semiconductor-superconductor devices into scalable and CMOS compatible architectures remains an outstanding challenge, currently hindering their practical implementation. Here, we demonstrate growth of InAs nanowires monolithically integrated on Si inside lateral cavities containing superconducting TiN elements. This technique allows growth of hybrid devices characterized by sharp semiconductor-superconductor interfaces and with alignment along arbitrary crystallographic directions.

arxiv-2405-17824.title: mTREE: Multi-Level Text-Guided Representation End-to-End Learning for Whole Slide Image Analysis
arxiv-2405-17824.creator: Quan Liu, Ruining Deng, Can Cui, Tianyuan Yao, Vishwesh Nath, Yucheng Tang, Yuankai Huo
arxiv-2405-17824.description: Abstract Multi-modal learning adeptly integrates visual and textual data, but its application to histopathology image and text analysis remains challenging, particularly with large, high-resolution images like gigapixel Whole Slide Images (WSIs). Current methods typically rely on manual region labeling or multi-stage learning to assemble local representations (e.g., patch-level) into global features (e.g., slide-level).

arxiv-2412-01508.title: HaGRIDv2: 1M Images for Static and Dynamic Hand Gesture Recognition
arxiv-2412-01508.creator: Anton Nuzhdin, Alexander Nagaev, Alexander Sautin, Alexander Kapitanov, Karina Kvanchiani, SberDevices, Russia
arxiv-2412-01508.description: Abstract This paper proposes the second version of the widespread Hand Gesture Recognition dataset HaGRID – HaGRIDv2. We cover 15 new gestures with conversation and control functions, including two-handed ones. Building on the foundational concepts proposed by HaGRID’s authors, we implemented the dynamic gesture recognition algorithm and further enhanced it by adding three new groups of manipulation gestures.

arxiv-2501-01879.title: Superstrong magnetic fields in sunspot bipolar light bridges
arxiv-2501-01879.creator: J. S. Castellanos Durán, A. Korpi-Lagg, S. K. Solanki, M. van Noort, N. Milanovic
arxiv-2501-01879.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by J. S. Castellanos Durán, A. Korpi-Lagg, S. K. Solanki, M. van Noort, N. Milanovic. Recent solar observations of bipolar light bridges (BLBs) in sunspots have, in a few individual cases, revealed magnetic fields up to 8.2 kG, which is at least twice as strong as typical values measured in sunspot umbrae. However, the small number of such observations hinted that such strong fields in these bright photospheric features that separate two opposite-polarity umbrae, are a rare phenomenon.

arxiv-2503-02674.title: Towards a Robust Expert Finding in Community Question Answering Platforms
arxiv-2503-02674.creator: Maddalena Amendola, Andrea Passarella, Raffaele Perego
arxiv-2503-02674.description: Abstract This paper introduces TUEF, a topic-oriented user-interaction model for fair Expert Finding in Community Question Answering (CQA) platforms. The Expert Finding task in CQA platforms involves identifying proficient users capable of providing accurate answers to questions from the community. To this aim, TUEF improves the robustness and credibility of the CQA platform through a more precise Expert Finding component.

arxiv-2601-06910.description: Abstract . Penetration testing is essential for identifying vulnerabilities in web applications before real adversaries can exploit them. Recent work has explored automating this process with Large Language Model (LLM)-powered agents, but existing approaches either rely on a single generic agent that struggles in complex scenarios or narrowly specialized agents that cannot adapt to diverse vulnerability types.

pmc-10660010.title: Mitochondrial injury during normothermic regional perfusion (NRP) and hypothermic oxygenated perfusion (HOPE) in a rodent model of DCD liver transplantation
pmc-10660010.creator: Rebecca Panconesi, Mauricio Flores Carvalho, Janina Eden, Marilena Fazi, Fariha Ansari, Leandro Mancina, Nadia Navari, Richard Xavier Sousa Da Silva, Daniele Dondossola, Lucia Bautista Borrego, Matthias Pietzke, Adriano Peris, David Meierhofer, Paolo Muiesan, Alexander Galkin, Fabio Marra, Philipp D
pmc-10660010.description: SummaryBackgroundNormothermic regional perfusion (NRP) and hypothermic-oxygenated-perfusion (HOPE), were both shown to improve outcomes after liver transplantation from donors after circulatory death (DCD). Comparative clinical and mechanistical studies are however lacking.MethodsA rodent model of NRP and HOPE, both in the donor, was developed.

pmc-11458807.title: Maternal blood endometase level as a predictive biomarker for hypertensive disorders during pregnancy: a prospective cohort study
pmc-11458807.creator: Mustafa Can Sivas, Handan Turhan Karakus, Serkan Ozbey, Alper Gumus
pmc-11458807.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Preeclampsia (PE) occurs due to inadequate spiral artery/trophoblast remodeling in early pregnancy. Endometases are involved in the remodeling of spiral arteries and placental trophoblasts. This study aimed to investigate differences in blood endometase levels between pregnant women with hypertensive disorders (PE and gestational hypertension [GHT]) and healthy pregnant women and to evaluate whether plasma endometase values ​​could play a predictive role in PE or GHT diagnosis.

pmc-11476289.title: The spatial impact of a Western diet in enriching Galectin-1-regulated Rho, ECM, and SASP signaling in a novel MASH-HCC mouse model
pmc-11476289.creator: Tahereh Setayesh, Ying Hu, Farzam Vaziri, Dongguang Wei, Yu-Jui Yvonne Wan
pmc-11476289.description: BackgroundHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) arising from metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) presents a significant clinical challenge, particularly given the prevalence of the Western diet (WD). The influence of diet on the tumor microenvironment remains poorly understood. Galectin-1 (Gal-1) is a biomarker for HCC and has a crucial role in liver carcinogenesis. Our previous studies demonstrated that silencing Gal-1 effectively treats mouse HCC.

pmc-11495329.title: Enough but not too many: A bi-threshold model for behavioral diffusion
pmc-11495329.creator: Fahimeh Alipour, Fedor Dokshin, Zeinab Maleki, Yunya Song, Pouria Ramazi
pmc-11495329.description: Behavioral diffusion is commonly modeled with the linear threshold model, which assumes that individuals adopt a behavior when enough of their social contacts do so. We observe, however, that in many common empirical settings individuals also appear to abandon a behavior when too many of their close contacts exhibit it.

pmc-11496621.title: Dynamically cultured, differentiated bovine adipose-derived stem cell spheroids as building blocks for biofabricating cultured fat
pmc-11496621.creator: Annemarie Klatt, Jannis O. Wollschlaeger, Franziska B. Albrecht, Sara Rühle, Lena B. Holzwarth, Holger Hrenn, Tanja Melzer, Simon Heine, Petra J. Kluger
pmc-11496621.description: Cultured or cultivated meat, animal muscle, and fat tissue grown in vitro, could transform the global meat market, reducing animal suffering while using fewer resources than traditional meat production and no antimicrobials at all. To ensure the appeal of cultured meat to future customers, cultured fat is essential for achieving desired mouthfeel, taste, and texture, especially in beef.

pmc-12566820.title: Research on Enhancing the Solubility and Bioavailability of Canagliflozin Using Spray Drying Techniques with a Quality-by-Design Approach
pmc-12566820.creator: Ji Ho Lee, Seong Uk Choi, Tae Jong Kim, Na Yoon Jeong, Hyun Seo Paeng, Kyeong Soo Kim, Wihan Pheiffer, Dewald Steyn, Sias Hamman
pmc-12566820.description: Objectives: The objective of this study was to enhance the solubility and bioavailability of canagliflozin (CFZ) using a spray drying technique with a Quality-by-Design (QbD) approach. Methods: The formulation of CFZ-loaded solid dispersions (CFZ-SDs) was optimized using a Box–Behnken design (BBD) with three factors at three levels, resulting in a total of fifteen experiments, including three central point replicates.

pmc-12743799.title: Assessment of Abortion Methods, Management, and Patient Satisfaction Among Women Seeking Safe Abortion Services in a Tertiary Care Hospital, Nepal
pmc-12743799.creator: Sonika Thapa, Nirmal Raj Marasine, Shishir Paudel, Sagun Thapa, Sabina Sankhi, Prayas Ghimire
pmc-12743799.description: Background:Unsafe abortion is a major contributor to maternal mortality in low- and middle-income countries. Despite the legalization of abortion and expanded access to services in Nepal, data on abortion practices and patient satisfaction remain limited.Objective:This study aimed to assess abortion methods, their management, and patient satisfaction among women seeking safe abortion services at a tertiary care hospital in Kathmandu, Nepal.

pmc-13212845.title: Taming Lattice Strain via Buried Interface Engineering for Reverse-Bias Resilient Perovskite Solar Cells
pmc-13212845.creator: Niqian Du, Shanshan Du, Yaru Du, Xiaobo Zhang, Xiaoyi Hou, Chi Feng, Rongdong Xiang, Xin Wu, Heping Fu, Zhiyong Liu, Tingwei He, Kaikai Liu
pmc-13212845.description: Highlights Modulating perovskite lattice strain, beyond merely managing ion migration or passivating defects, is pivotal for device efficiency and stability.Buried interface engineering simultaneously optimizes the hole-transport-layer, templates film growth and passivates defects, thereby mitigating perovskite lattice strain.Inverted perovskite solar cells achieve a power conversion efficiency of 26.10% with exceptional stability under reverse-bias, thermal, and operational stresses.

pmc-13214238.title: Risk of bias among Chinese-language randomized controlled trials on Chinese herbal medicine included in meta-analyses published in 2021–2022: A cross-sectional study
pmc-13214238.creator: Yue Jiang, Claire Chenwen Zhong, Betty Huan Wang, Shanshan Xu, Fai Fai Ho, Ming Hong Kwong, Leonard Ho, Joson Hao-Shen Zhou, KC Lam, Jian-ping Liu, Bao-ting Zhang, Vincent CH Chung
pmc-13214238.description: BackgroundThe reliability of meta-analyses on Chinese herbal medicine (CHM) largely depends on the methodological quality of the included randomized controlled trials (RCTs). This study assessed the risk of bias (RoB) among Chinese-language CHM RCTs embedded in meta-analyses (MAs) published between 2021 and 2022.MethodsChinese-language CHM MAs were identified through literature searches across seven databases (three international and four Chinese databases).

pmc-13245399.title: Genetic analysis of limbic-predominant age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy neuropathologic change in a population-based cohort of the oldest old
pmc-13245399.creator: Elizaveta Mikhailenko, Sara Savola, Mia Kero, Pentti J Tienari, Liisa Myllykangas, Karri Kaivola
pmc-13245399.description: Limbic-predominant age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy neuropathologic change is a common proteinopathy in the oldest old that is associated with cognitive decline. Although the genetic basis of limbic-predominant age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy neuropathologic change remains largely unknown, TMEM106B, GRN and APOE loci are frequently implicated.

pmc-13271424.title: Willingness to Undergo Corrective Surgery After Breast-Conserving Surgery in Chinese Patients with Breast Deformities: A Single-Center Study
pmc-13271424.creator: Jingyan Zhang, Zejun Wu, Jingyan Gao, Fang Gao, Fan Guo

pmc-13296470.title: From Particles to Chemicals: Redefining the Impact of Agricultural Plastics on Water Quality
pmc-13296470.creator: Wei Chen, Thilo Hofmann
pmc-13296470.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ), polypropylene (PP), polyvinyl chloride (PVC), and ethylene-vinyl acetate (EVA) are now widely embedded in agricultural systems. Given their agronomic benefits, agricultural plastics as a whole are unlikely to be replaced at scale. Thus, their widespread and persistent use makes understanding their environmental footprint a central priority, particularly in the context of water quality, as agricultural soils act as key interfaces that control contaminant fluxes to groundwater, surface waters, and ultimately drinking water systems.

pmc-13330068.title: Targeted KEAP1 disruption enhances antioxidant defense and mesenchymal stromal cell therapy for chronic limb-threatening ischemia
pmc-13330068.creator: Eun Ji Shin, Yuri Choi, Eun Je Jeon, Kang-in Lee, Kyu-jun Lee, Young Ju Son, Min Ji Son, Seokjoong Kim, Seung-Woo Cho, Jae Young Lee
pmc-13330068.description: Chronic limb-threatening ischemia (CLTI) is a severe vascular disorder characterized by tissue hypoxia and oxidative stress that limit the efficacy of regenerative therapies. Mesenchymal stem/stromal cells (MSCs) hold promise for CLTI treatment through paracrine angiogenic and immunomodulatory signaling, yet their survival and function are compromised in the reactive oxygen species-rich ischemic microenvironment.

pmc-13538206.title: Skin barrier repairing and anti-aging effects evaluation of a comprehensive topical regimen incorporating niacinamide, Pro-Xylane, and panthenol after PicoWay laser: a randomized controlled study
pmc-13538206.creator: Huijuan Liu, Baiyu Li, Xiaofeng He, Rui Li, Runlin Mi, Chunyu Zhao, Caixia Ye, Wenna Wang, Hequn Wang, Zailing Zhu, Xiaoyin Zhou, Kungchi Hsu, Andrew Steel, Jie Qiu, Yi Yi, Yueqing Niu, Claire Huguet, Wei Xiong, Valentine Beguin, Delphine Kerob, Yijie Zheng
pmc-13538206.description: Pro-Xylane is a potent anti-aging ingredient; however, there is limited knowledge regarding whether a comprehensive post-procedure regimen incorporating a combination of Pro-Xylane, niacinamide, and panthenol alongside other active agents can deliver synergistic benefits for both skin barrier repair and anti-aging.

pmc-13613837.title: Associations between 24-hour movement behavior and non-suicidal self-injury in adolescents: based on compositional data and isotemporal substitution analysis
pmc-13613837.creator: Yingzhe Gao, Xiaoqiang Zhang, Huijuan Hu, Lunxin Chen, Hui Zeng
pmc-13613837.description: BackgroundEvidence suggests that physical activity (PA) is closely associated with lower non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI). However, the relationship between 24-h movement behaviors and NSSI, as well as potential substitution effects among these behaviors, remains unclear. Therefore, this study investigates how relative time allocation across movement behaviors and the substitution effects between them relate to NSSI.

pmc-13670265.title: Influencing factors analysis and prediction model development for ROSC in adult non-traumatic OHCA: a retrospective study based on pre-hospital emergency settings
pmc-13670265.creator: Qing Zhang, Zhixin Pang, Xiangyu Yan, Feng Tang, Shuai Li, Xiaoying Shao, Wenrui Zou, Tongyu Xing, Shengli Guo, Xiangjun Meng, Nan Hu, Xiangyan Meng, Lu Lu, Shanglun Li, Haojun Fan
pmc-13670265.description: BackgroundCardiac arrest is a major global public health problem. This study aimed to explore factors influencing return of spontaneous circulation (ROSC) and develop a prediction model for out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) patients.MethodsWe retrospectively collected electronic medical records of adult non-traumatic OHCA patients at Tianjin Emergency Medical Center from January 1, 2023 to December 31, 2024.
